name: Delegable Action
description: The actions an authority delegation may transfer — approve, review, attest, submit, edit, acknowledge.

fields.label: Code
fields.description: Stable identifier. Used by integrations and imports; do not reuse a retired code.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Inactive values stay on historical records but are not offered for new ones.

fields.label: Sort Order
fields.description: Presentation order where alphabetical is wrong.

fields.label: External Code
fields.description: The identifier this value carries in whatever system of record eventually owns it. Reserved now so a future reconciliation needs no migration.

fields.label: Administrative Task
fields.description: Delegation is restricted to administrative tasks by default; a non-administrative action must be enabled deliberately.

provenance: §4.3; 02-data-model.md §11 I-3. Without it delegation is all-or-nothing, which conflicts with the segregation-of-duties requirement.]
